title: Existence of exact graded presentation data
statement: For a closed immersion j and an invertible module L with square-zero ideal, there exists a TensorGradedPresentationCore j L containing all algebra, exactness, quotient, kernel, colimit, and projection data of the graded presentation, except the homogeneous multiplication equation.

proof.text: Construct O_X[T], its quotient by the square-zero ideal, and the ideal module locally on frames of L; glue along transition units and take the direct sum of the degreewise exact sequences.

mathlib_searches.query: graded tensor presentation square zero ideal

lean.statement: theorem tensorGradedPresentation_core_exists {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j] (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (hI : j.ker ^ 2 = ⊥) : Nonempty (TensorGradedPresentationCore j L)
